facts.fact: Burkina24 reports that the government's Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI) open data platform was officially presented at the national open data forum in Ouagadougou on 5 June 2014, with World Bank support, for free online release of non-sensitive public data; no dataset count is given.

systems.country_label: Burkina Open Data Initiative (BODI) open data platform
systems.owner: Ministry of Economy and Finance; ANPTIC

note: Only the education ministry is said to be setting up a section on the platform; no two bodies are named as publishing, so no breadth fact.
